headline: BLACKPINK's Jisoo pitches in at Park Bo Gum's barbershop
sub: tvN's 'The Village Barber 2' premieres Nov 29 at 7:45 PM KST
caption:
BLACKPINK's Jisoo is joining Park Bo Gum's seaside barbershop as a one-day part-timer on tvN's 'The Village Barber 2'.

The new season premieres Sunday, Nov 29 at 7:45 PM KST, with Park Bo Gum and Lee Sang Yi running a hair salon in Tongyeong. It marks Jisoo's first variety show with Park Bo Gum, and the latest teaser shows her, Ahn Eun Jin and more stepping in to help the busy crew.

📌 Source: tvN, via Korean media
